profile.ja: 次元侵略者・ブレインフレーヤーによって壊滅の危機にある未来世界の神村舞華。多くの対魔忍が散って行く中で終末世界を生き残り隠遁生活を送っていたが戦線に復帰。最高クラスの火炎を完全に操る爆炎あらため火神の対魔忍。時を経て、荒々しいヤンキー娘から大人の魅力溢れるお姉さんに進化している。
profile.en: She is Kamimura Maika from a future world on the brink of destruction due to the Dimensional Invaders and Brain Flayers. Many Taimanin have fallen, but she has survived in a post-apocalyptic world, living in hiding as a former Taimanin. She is a retired Explosive Flame Big Sister who can fully manipulate top-class flames and is also known as the Taimanin of Explosive Flames, or the Fire God. Over time, she has evolved from a rough, tomboyish girl to a charming, mature woman.

text.ja: い、いよお、ふうま……！　会えてめちゃくちゃ嬉しいんだがよ、その、なんか、服……ねえか？
